author: @gringus

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API changes. The /v1/embeddings endpoint accepts the same request schema; only the internal model name sent to the FLM backend changes. Clients sending lemonade model ids (e.g. embed-gemma-300m-FLM) now get correct embeddings instead of a 400 — a fix, not a break.
evidence.documentation: No documentation update needed. The change is a bug fix that restores expected behavior for FLM embedding models through the OpenAI-compatible API. The fix aligns with the existing pattern documented in the code comments for the sibling paths.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This changes a user-facing API endpoint (/v1/embeddings) and is the first FLM-specific test for the embeddings path. The author's testing on real hardware is thorough but should be validated on a release candidate to confirm no regression. See Maintainer To-Do.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first and only approval (2026-11-20T06:30:29Z). The branch contained a single commit that was identical to what was merged.
evidence.review: PR #4166 has one substantive review from @iswaryaalex (FastFlowLM maintainer per contribute.md), who approved the code change. @iswaryaalex left one inline comment suggesting the comment match the two-line style used by the sibling paths and avoid issue numbers per AGENTS.md; the author did not adopt this suggestion but @iswaryaalex still approved. The reviewer's feedback was limited to comment style and an observation about FLM 1.0.11 ignoring the model field — no substantive code concerns were raised.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change modifies a local JSON field within the C++ server before forwarding to the FLM backend; no new network calls, credential handling, or permission changes.
evidence.tests: No new or modified tests accompany this change. The existing embedding test in test/server_router.py exercises llamacpp models (nomic-embed-text-v1-GGUF) only, not the FLM embeddings path. The author provided detailed manual test results on Ryzen AI hardware with FLM 1.0.13, including a real-world RAG scenario — this is valuable evidence but does not substitute for automated coverage.

maintainer_todos.text: Start the server with an FLM embedding model (e.g. embed-gemma:300m via flm serve --embed 1) and POST to /v1/embeddings with model set to the lemonade model id (e.g. embed-gemma-300m-FLM); confirm the request succeeds and returns vectors instead of a 400 error.
Verify the embeddings response is identical when the same input is submitted twice, confirming bit-identical output across repeated requests.

Test the same endpoint with an FLM model that is not an embedding model (classification or transcription); confirm it still returns a 400 UnsupportedOperation error rather than succeeding or crashing.

subject: fix(flm): forward the flm checkpoint in embeddings() (#4166)
summary: Translates the model name from lemonade's FLM model id (e.g. embed-gemma-300m-FLM) to the FLM checkpoint name (e.g. embed-gemma:300m) in FastFlowLMServer::embeddings(), matching the behavior already present in chat_completions(), completion() and forward_streaming_request() so FLM embedding models work through the OpenAI-compatible API.
verdict_reason: The fix is sound and adequately reviewed, but introduces user-visible API behavior that was not exercised by automated tests and the PR author's manual testing should be verified on a release candidate.
